sentences.span: The dominant story of the week was the Fed's first rate hike in over three years — a unanimous +25bps
sentences.why: Directly confirms the first Fed hike in three years.

sentences.span: With the Fed, ECB and BoJ all hiking in the last two weeks, it's clear we're back in a globally synchronised rate hiking cycle, with markets pricing more to come... even though hikes are underway, there are credible reasons why investors risk underestimating the scale of the tightening ahead
sentences.why: DB's explicit stance that the hike is the start of a longer tightening cycle, not the end of the repricing — a bank's stance, so the opinion-shaped framing is faithful.

sentences.span: down -4.5bps to 4.95% while the 2yr yield actually inched up +0.3bps to 4.75%
sentences.why: No source gives a 10-year print of 4.99%; the closest values across the corpus are 4.95-4.96%. A live 'right now' price claim with no matching source figure is unsupported.

sentences.span: these agentic workflows require continuous web browsing, API calls, and multi-step execution, they are significantly more CPU- and inference-heavy than basic text queries. Investors quickly connected this trend to an impending wave of demand for advanced processors... revitalizing the broader tech hardware supply chain
sentences.why: The 'hardware order' framing is a reasonable paraphrase of Goldman's supply-chain point, but no source anywhere in the corpus makes the specific claim that this is 'the part of the AI trade with the fewest people arguing against it' — that consensus superlative is unsourced editorializing.

sentences.span: Apptopia estimated 1.8 million iOS downloads for Muse in the US and Canada, versus 1.3 million for ChatGPT [over an equivalent period, 13 days following mobile launch]
sentences.why: UBS download figures match exactly; the 21%/+1% share move is separately confirmed in JPM's Meta note (up 21% since the launch of Muse 2 weeks ago, vs. the SPX +1%) and is not misattributed since the (UBS) tag is scoped to the downloads clause only.

sentences.span: Samsung HBM4 yields have reportedly reached ~80%, up from below 60% in early mass production... NAND is also improving, with tech specialists pointing to roughly 20% QoQ pricing upside in both 3Q and 4Q
sentences.why: Both the HBM4 yield figures and the 20% flash (NAND) pricing rise for two straight quarters are confirmed in this Goldman note; the compute-intensity reasoning is confirmed in the companion Goldman Muse-mania note.

sentences.span: Less than 30% of S&P stocks are now above the 50-day moving average
sentences.why: Exact match on the <30% breadth figure (Goldman). The 52-week lows-beating-highs streak is separately confirmed in BTIG's 'Super-ficial Rally' note (five straight days), unattributed in the sentence but not misattributed.

sentences.span: The CCC minus single-B spread has widened to 799bp, close to the top of its available three-year range
sentences.why: Exact match; CCC vs single-B is the weakest tier vs the tier above it.

sentences.span: The six-month ATM implied-volatility spread between IWM and SPX has fallen close to the bottom of its two-year range
sentences.why: Matches 'barely more than SPX, near a two-year low' — same document, GS-attributed section.

sentences.span: There have been some headlines about potential for the US to curtail diesel exports... however, we think this unlikely given it would not solve medium term global supply issues and is expected to get pushback from US refining industry
sentences.why: The diesel price clause ($6.29, up 68% from $3.74, EIA) is exact and faithful (source-text-all/2026-09-22/17266). But no source shows Trump personally backing an export ban 'Tuesday evening' — JPM's note (17527) describes only Republican lawmakers pushing the Trump administration, calling it an open 'debate,' and Goldman explicitly calls a curtailment unlikely. A live policy debate is presented as a resolved presidential decision with a fabricated timestamp.

sentences.span: The ICE gasoil crack spread has risen to around $95/bbl this week, up from an average of roughly $74/bbl in August
sentences.why: Gasoil crack spread is the refining margin for turning crude into diesel/gasoil; figures match exactly (ING).

sentences.span: (no mention of export-ban risk to the crack-spread trade anywhere in the ING note)
sentences.why: No source connects a diesel export ban to compression of the refiner crack-spread trade specifically; this causal framing is unsourced analytical synthesis layered on an already-unconfirmed premise (s10).

sentences.span: This marks the sixth consecutive year the IAEA has revised its projections higher... where ~60% of new nuclear capacity could come from SMRs
sentences.why: 60% is fairly described as 'most' of new North American capacity; sixth-year figure matches exactly.

sentences.span: the US-South Korea nuclear power investment agreement is set to be signed on September 18... Figure 1: In August, long-term uranium contract prices reached US$97/lb, hitting a record high
sentences.why: Two problems: (1) Yuanta frames the $120bn deal as 'set to be signed' — a plan, not a confirmed completed signing — and no later source in the corpus confirms the signing actually happened; a conditional is presented as an asserted past event. (2) The $96.50/lb figure attributed to '(Yuanta)' is not Yuanta's own number — Yuanta's document states $97/lb; the $96.50 figure instead comes from a different bank's note (Northland Capital Markets, 17438).

sentences.span: To meet demand for nuclear power generation, uranium prices need to rise to US$120/lb, so as to match supply with demand
sentences.why: Exact match to Yuanta's stated $120/lb target and its rationale (balancing supply/demand); the flat-cycle invalidation is the pulse's own falsifiable framing and does not misstate any source fact.
